ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels with minimal high-intensity white pixel coverage limited to small speckles and distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly contiguous solid black pigmentation across 95%+ of the visible surface. High-frequency, low-diameter white pixel speckles are distributed across both lobes. High-contrast tan/brown textured clusters are localized at the extreme lateral terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 85 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by 8-12 distinct rounded peaks (serrations) per lobe, with larger amplitude variations occurring mid-lobe and decreasing in frequency toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the notch toward the distal tips, terminating in a sharp upward taper at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 20-30 discrete white circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle scars) scattered across the mid-ventral region of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured clusters of brownish/tan pixels at both distal tips consistent with significant barnacle colonization. Several faint circular indentations are visible on the interior surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical moisture streak or light-gray band extending from the central notch toward the submerged peduncle area.
